column1: Total Population, Household Population, and Number of Households by Province, City, Municipality, and Barangay as of 01 July 2024: CALABARZON

Total population defines as the sum of the household population and the institutional population, covering all persons living within a specific territory at a given reference time, including Filipinos in embassies or missions abroad.

Household Population: All persons who are members of a private household, meaning a person or group of persons sleeping in the same housing unit with common arrangements for food preparation and consumption.
Institutional Population: Persons living in institutional living quarters (ILQs) such as penal/corrective institutions, dormitories, hotels, military camps, or welfare facilities.
Household is defined as a social unit consisting of a person or a group of persons who sleep in the same housing unit and have a common arrangement in the preparation and consumption of food.
Source of Basic Data: 2024 Census of Population
Level of Disaggregation: Region, Province and Highly Urbanized City, City/Municipality, and Barangay
